In the morning, transfer to Barreirinhas, a journey of about 4 hours. On arrival, transfer to the hotel.

Then explore Lençóis Maranhenses National Park in the north-east of Maranhão state. The park covers about 1,550 square kilometres. Its main feature is the vast fields of white sand dunes, with freshwater lagoons forming between them. The Portuguese name Lençóis means ‘sheets’. From a distance, the pale dunes really do look like one large sheet.

During the rainy season, usually from January to June, water collects in the hollows between the dunes, forming thousands of blue and green lagoons. The contrast between the dry white sand and the clear freshwater creates the landscape that draws travellers here. In some places, the lagoons are separated by little more than the crests of the dunes.

One of the best-known stops is Lagoa Bonita. It lies in an elevated part of the park and is surrounded by a network of lagoons between the dunes. To reach the viewpoint, climb a dune about 30 metres high. From the top, you can see the pale sand, the water and the restinga forest. The green strip of forest looks like a wall holding the dunes in place. From here, you can see how the lagoons lie between the ridges of sand and how far the park extends.

After the climb, you can rest and swim in Lagoa Bonita. You can also visit Lagoa do Clone, where the TV series The Clone was filmed. You can swim, dive and sunbathe there.

Overnight in Barreirinhas.
Aerial view of white sand dunes and blue-green lagoons in Lençóis Maranhenses, Brazil
Lençóis Maranhenses: winding dunes and lagoons from above
Preguiças River – Pequenos Lençóis – São Luís

Travel by speedboat along the Preguiças River, with panoramic views of the banks and vegetation along the way. With luck, you may see monkeys.

Next, climb the lighthouse for a clear view of Pequenos Lençóis. There will be time for photos and stops at clear-water lagoons where you can cool off and swim.

After the excursion, transfer to São Luís. Overnight in São Luís.
